predicate_semantics.absent_key: A predicate key that is absent does not constrain the rule; the rule applies.
predicate_semantics.match: "any_night" means the predicate fires if ANY night of the stay falls inside the window.

predicate_semantics.text_match: Case-insensitive substring match of any_of[] against any of fields[].
